focusedTest.command: fvm flutter test test/features/chat/presentation/providers/chat_notifier_test.dart --plain-name "goal auto-continue dispatches one hidden continuation from current evidence"
focusedTest.testName: goal auto-continue dispatches one hidden continuation from current evidence
focusedTest.contract: An incomplete diagnostic turn emits a structured continue decision, dispatches exactly one hidden continuation, then records a structured skip after verification clears the incomplete evidence.

expectedEvidence.description: The test waits for two turns and observes the automatic hidden continuation prompt.
The focused test requires ordered turn exits and goal decisions, including continue then skip.

liveCanary.testName: live LLM auto-continues the todo_app.md MVP fixture from diagnostic evidence
liveCanary.contract: A live coding goal produces repeated structured auto-continue decisions from verifier diagnostics, proves ordered turn-exit to decision to continuation-request flow, improves or clears evidence, and reaches a terminal goal condition.

expectedEvidence.description: The session log contains at least two goal auto-continue decisions with unresolved diagnostics.
The canary observes turn exit, auto-continue decision, and continuation request in order.
Diagnostic evidence strictly decreases or the verifier reaches terminal success.
The goal completes, blocks explicitly, or exhausts its turn budget.
